项目简介
本项目于2025年成功交付了一套一体化低空反制系统。系统通过部署固定式频谱探测设备与固定式频谱干扰设备，在炼油厂关键区域形成了严密的常态化防御圈，能够自动识别并阻断非法无人机的入侵。依托指挥控制平台软件的智能分析与集中管控，实现了对低空威胁的“侦测、识别、干扰”闭环处理，实现了设备的统一调度与自动化响应，不仅大幅降低了人工值守成本，更显著提升了炼油厂应对无人机侦察与袭扰的应急处置效率，确保能源生产线的平稳运行。
description_en:
2025 Anti-UAV Case of a Refinery in Brazil
Equipment Used:
Stationary Spectrum Detection Equipment
Stationary Spectrum Interference Equipment
Command and Control Platform Software
Project Introduction:
In 2025, this project successfully delivered an integrated low-altitude countermeasure system. By deploying stationary spectrum detection equipment and stationary spectrum interference equipment, the system formed a strict, normalized defense circle in key areas of the refinery, capable of automatically identifying and blocking illegal drone intrusions. Relying on the intelligent analysis and centralized management of the command and control platform software, it achieved a closed-loop processing of "detection, identification, and interference" for low-altitude threats. It also realized the unified dispatch and automated response of equipment, which not only significantly reduced the cost of manual duty but also greatly improved the emergency disposal efficiency of the refinery in coping with drone reconnaissance and harassment, ensuring the smooth operation of the energy production line.
